text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen has finally arrived, and Mejiro Dober is overwhelmed by the caliber of the senior racers she's to compete against.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's when Air Groove appears, exuding her usual oppressive air, and Mejiro Dober finds herself nearly suffocated by it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Mejiro Dober refuses to be overwhelmed and stands her ground! The final race of her classic year is about to begin!
